source.english_context: Unit 12 Work, Pay, and Workplace Norms Goal: understand job basics, schedules, pay words, and polite workplace questions. Daily Life English What is my schedule this week? When is payday? Can you show me how to clock in? I need to ask about my pay stub. Could you explain this task again? Which task should I do first? Who should I contact if I am sick? Can I change my shift on Friday? Where can I find the safety instructions? I have finished this task. Could you check whether I did this correctly? How do I request a day off? There may be a mistake in my recorded hours. When is the team meeting? Could you send me the instructions in writing? Vocabulary shift the hours a person works payday the day workers are paid pay stub a document showing pay and deductions overtime extra work hours beyond regular hours manager a person who leads workers break a short rest time at work clock in record the time when you start work clock out record the time when you finish work time sheet a record of the hours you worked coworker a person you work with training practice or instruction for learning a skill day off a day when you do not have to work US Customs Work permission, tax forms, pay rules, and benefits depend on your situation. Ask questions early if you do not understand a schedule or task. It is normal to confirm instructions: "Just to make sure, you want me to..." Dialogue Student: Could you show me how to clock in? Manager: Sure. Use this screen and enter your ID. Student: Thank you. What time is my break? Manager: Your break is at 11:00. Student: Got it. Thank you.

japanese_explanation.heading: 職場では確認が力になる
points: 勤務時間、休憩、給料日、制服、遅刻連絡の方法は最初に確認します。
分からない仕事は、黙って間違えるより、短く確認する方がよいです。Just to make sure... は便利です。
働く資格、税金、残業、福利厚生は状況で違います。重要な点は雇用主や専門家に確認しましょう。
japanese_explanation.practice: Just to make sure, you want me to clock in here?

existing_simplified_chinese.heading: 工作中确认很重要
points: 一开始要确认班表、休息时间、发薪日、制服和迟到时怎么联系。
不懂任务时，简短确认比默默做错更好。Just to make sure... 很有用。
工作许可、税、加班和福利会因个人情况不同。重要问题要向雇主或专业人士确认。
existing_simplified_chinese.practice: Just to make sure, you want me to clock in here?

points: 勤務時間、休憩、給料日、制服、遅刻連絡の方法は最初に確認します。
分からない仕事は、黙って間違えるより、短く確認する方がよいです。Just to make sure... は便利です。
働く資格、税金、残業、福利厚生は状況で違います。重要な点は雇用主や専門家に確認しましょう。

ko.heading: 직장에서의 확인은 힘이 됩니다
points: 근무 시간, 휴식 시간, 급여일, 유니폼, 지각 시 연락 방법을 미리 확인하세요.
모르는 업무는 조용히 실수하는 것보다 짧게 확인하는 것이 좋습니다. "Just to make sure..."는 유용합니다.
근무 자격, 세금, 초과 근무, 복리후생은 상황에 따라 다릅니다. 중요한 점은 고용주나 전문가에게 확인해야 합니다.

zh-Hans.heading: 工作中确认很重要
points: 一开始要确认班表、休息时间、发薪日、制服和迟到时怎么联系。
不懂任务时，简短确认比默默做错更好。"Just to make sure..." 很有用。
工作许可、税、加班和福利会因个人情况不同。重要问题要向雇主或专业人士确认。

es.heading: Confirmar en el trabajo es clave
points: Confirme al principio el horario de trabajo, las pausas, el día de pago, el uniforme y cómo informar una llegada tarde.
Para las tareas que no entienda, es mejor preguntar brevemente que equivocarse en silencio. La expresión "Just to make sure..." es útil.
Los requisitos para trabajar, los impuestos, las horas extras y los beneficios varían según su situación. Los puntos importantes deben confirmarse con su empleador o con un profesional.

pt-BR.heading: A confirmação no trabalho é um diferencial
points: Confirme desde o início o horário de trabalho, as pausas, o dia do pagamento, o uniforme e como notificar atrasos.
Para tarefas que não entenda, é melhor confirmar brevemente do que cometer um erro em silêncio. A expressão "Just to make sure..." é útil.
A permissão de trabalho, os impostos, as horas extras e os benefícios variam de acordo com a sua situação. Pontos importantes devem ser confirmados com seu empregador ou com um profissional.

fr.heading: Confirmer au travail est un atout
points: Confirmez au début vos horaires de travail, vos pauses, le jour de paie, l'uniforme et la procédure en cas de retard.
Pour les tâches que vous ne comprenez pas, il vaut mieux demander une brève confirmation que de faire une erreur en silence. L'expression « Just to make sure... » est utile.

Les droits de travail, les impôts, les heures supplémentaires et les avantages sociaux varient selon votre situation. Les points importants doivent être confirmés auprès de votre employeur ou d'un professionnel.

de.heading: Bestätigung am Arbeitsplatz ist ein Vorteil
points: Klären Sie zu Beginn Arbeitszeiten, Pausen, den Zahltag, die Arbeitskleidung und wie Sie Verspätungen melden.
Bei Aufgaben, die Sie nicht verstehen, ist es besser, kurz nachzufragen, als schweigend Fehler zu machen. Die Formulierung „Just to make sure...“ ist nützlich.
Arbeitserlaubnis, Steuern, Überstunden und Sozialleistungen variieren je nach Ihrer Situation. Wichtige Punkte sollten Sie mit Ihrem Arbeitgeber oder einem Fachmann klären.
